C0760.title: Shanghai Releases 2025 Network Data Security Enforcement Cases
keywords: standard contract for personal information export
C0760.summary: On January 16, 2026, the Shanghai Cyberspace Administration released typical 2025 network data security enforcement cases, stating that some companies failed to fulfill their primary responsibility for network data security, resulting in data leakage or leakage risk and leading to rectification orders or administrative penalties. The cases emphasize that network data processors should establish data classification, access control, log auditing, and risk response mechanisms, continuously review data processing activities, and avoid personal information and important data security problems caused by management gaps.
